title: Decisions
description: Questions Sifty could not answer on its own, and things it noticed, in one place.

waiting.both: {questions, plural, one {One question} other {# questions}} Sifty could not answer on its own, and {proposals, plural, one {one thing Sifty noticed about you} other {# things Sifty noticed about you}}. One tap each.
waiting.questions: {questions, plural, one {One question} other {# questions}} Sifty could not answer on its own. One tap each, or let it decide.
waiting.proposals: {proposals, plural, one {One thing Sifty noticed about you} other {# things Sifty noticed about you}}. Remember it, or not.

link.answered: Answered — Sifty is re-sifting with your reply.
link.dismissed: Dismissed — Sifty kept its own read.
link.gone: That question is no longer open.
link.busy: Too many taps in a minute — the question is still open below.
link.expired: That link expired. Anything still open is listed here.
link.invalid: That link is not valid. Anything still open is listed here.

toast.remembered: Remembered — Sifty will use it from the next sift on.
toast.noted: Noted — Sifty won't suggest that again.
toast.keptRead: Sifty kept its own read of “{title}”. Re-sift the task anytime.

empty.title: Nothing waiting on you.
empty.subtitle: Sifty only interrupts when a guess would be worse than a question.
empty.questions: <hl>Clarifying questions</hl> — when a sift is unsure what you meant, one short question shows up here instead of a wrong guess.
empty.memory: <hl>Memory suggestions</hl> — preferences Sifty notices in your edits, for you to keep or drop.
empty.approvals: <hl>Approvals</hl> — drafts and actions an agent prepared, waiting for your go-ahead.
